 Close Main Menu Open Search Open Schedule Ticker Close search Ben Smith / UCF Athletics November 19, 2026 Football vs. Iowa State | Weather and Gameday Updates
 by Ken Landis Share Twitter Facebook Email ORLANDO - Friday night’s UCF football game against Iowa State remains on as scheduled. Heavy rainfall has led to changes to parking, tailgating and stadium entry. Please review the updates below before heading to campus.
 UCF is in contact with the National Weather Service and continues to monitor weather conditions. For the latest updates, check this page regularly, follow UCF Knights on social media and turn on notifications in the UCF mobile app .
 Parking 
 Opening times 
 1 p.m. — Kenneth G. Dixon Athletics Village Gold Zone lots and Garage F
 3:30 p.m. — Campus Gold Zone and campus lots
 Garage F will open with the Athletics Village lots for this game.
 Lot closures and relocations 
 Affected parking/lot closures include Baseball Lot, Baseball OP6 and Arboretum. Those affected will be contacted with new parking arrangements.
 Click here for additional parking information.
 Tailgating/Pregame Festivities: 
 Knights on the Mall has been canceled. The main sections of Memory Mall will be closed. Grassy areas along the perimeter will remain open for tailgating, and parking in the Memory Mall area will operate as usual.
 IOA Plaza pregame activations will be relocated to Nicholson Plaza on the SW corner of the stadium, near Gate 17. The pregame Corona Concert Series has been canceled.
 Knight Walk on IOA plaza has been moved to Gate 14.
 Senior Knight recognition will remain on as scheduled, weather permitting.
 Stadium Entry 
 Gate closures:  Gates 5, 8, 9, 11 and 16B will be closed, along with two entrances at Gate 14.
 Student entry:  There will be no student standby line.
 Media Will Call:  Media credentials can be picked up at the West Ticket Office.
 Thank you for your flexibility as we work through these changes.
 Go Knights, Charge On!
